name: Orreaga / Roncesvalles (Spain)
description: Greyish olive field charged at the centre with a white cross within a ring of crescents, the emblem of the collegiate church of Roncesvalles.
history: Municipal flag of Orreaga-Roncesvalles; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross with a crozier within a ring of crescents
